# TikTok

Generated from [tokens.json](tokens.json) and [README.md](README.md) by the design-systems catalog tool. Do not edit this file: change the tokens through the package's builders, then run `make design-md` at the repository root.

It follows the DESIGN.md spec, version alpha. That format has no themes, no per-value provenance and only px, em and rem units, so this file holds the `dark` theme alone with every alias resolved. [tokens.json](tokens.json) is the source of truth: it records where each value was read, and keeps the 10 tokens from these groups that DESIGN.md cannot hold (gradients, shadows, percentages, durations and other non-colour or non-px values).

## Overview

Good for: Signed-out video chrome: black page, razzmatazz login button, cyan-and-pink wordmark, capsule search, 24px login sheet.

Captured 2026-11-19, signed out. Public marketing and login chrome only. No account, no phone, no email.. Themes: dark.

Public signed-out chrome for TikTok, captured 2026-11-19 from https://www.tiktok.com/. No account. English. One dark theme. Desktop readings are at innerWidth 1169, innerHeight 731, devicePixelRatio 2. Phone readings are the same URL at innerWidth 390, innerHeight 844, devicePixelRatio 2. A 1440 CSS-pixel width was not reached. The login dialog said the account location is Singapore.

## Typography

10 styles from `core.typography`. `fontFamily` is the first family of each stack; the full stacks, and properties DESIGN.md has no field for (text case, decoration), are in tokens.json. Families: TikTokDisplayFont, TikTokFont.

### Fonts (from README.md)

TikTokFont, then Arial, Tahoma, PingFangSC, sans-serif, for UI text. TikTokDisplayFont, then the same fallbacks, for the login title. Both TikTok families are proprietary and are not in this package. The style guide uses the fallback stack.

A second stack, TikTokSans, is declared on `--tux-v2-font-display` and `--tux-v2-font-text`. It was not the computed family of the measured controls.

## Do's and Don'ts

- Do take values from [tokens.json](tokens.json) when you need another theme, a value's source, or a token this file leaves out.
- Do read [README.md](README.md) before relying on a value; it says what is known to be wrong.
- Don't read colours off the screenshots; they are 256-colour PNGs.
- Don't copy the product's logo, icons, illustrations or brand colours into something that ships. Borrow structure and proportions.
- Don't edit this file; it is regenerated from the tokens.

### What to distrust (from README.md)

- Hover, pressed, disabled, error, and toast colours are declared custom properties or were not painted.
- The focus ring is a stylesheet rule for `:focus-visible`. No control was focused.
- Shadows in `core.shadow` are declared `--tux-v2-shadow-*` values. The measured controls had `box-shadow: none`.
- The ease token expands the CSS keyword. The 250ms duration was measured. The control points are the keyword's standard expansion, marked Derived.
- [screenshots/home-dark-unavailable.png](screenshots/home-dark-unavailable.png) is a black label, not a capture of the page. Do not sample colours from it.
- The hidden search form (radius 92px, fill white at 12%) had a painted size of 0. The visible search control is the capsule button.
- Feed captions, creator names, and counts are page content, not tokens.
- `--tux-colorPrimary` (`#ff3b5c`) and `--brand-tiktok-razzmatazz` (`#fe2c55`) are both on the page. The filled Log in button uses razzmatazz. The selected nav and the Sign up link use primary.

### Do and don't (from README.md)

- **Use razzmatazz for the filled Log in button.** `#fe2c55`, white type, 6px radius, 40px tall.
- **Use primary for the selected nav item and Sign up.** `#ff3b5c` on a transparent button.
- **Keep the page black and the sheet `#1e1e1e`.** Body type is white at 90%. Sidebar headings are white at 50%.
- **Put login channels on the white 13% pill.** 300 by 48, radius 24px, on the 24px sheet.
- **Do not invent a light theme.** These pages do not switch.
- **Do not draw a drop shadow on these controls.** None was measured. Declared shadows stay in the token file as declared.
